content: Hi Bhargav Kakati, Following your recent application, we are excited to let you know that you have been officially shortlisted for the HR Executive Internship Program here at Wellbridge Technologies. Our panel reviewed your background and determined that you would be a great addition to our upcoming remote cohort. Your personalized Welcome Letter is attached to this email. Internship Highlights: Role: HR Executive Intern, Duration: 1 Month, Mode: Remote / Bangalore, Stipend: As mentioned in the Welcome Letter. To confirm your participation: Submit your enrollment here: https://www.wellbridge.in/form. After reviewing the Welcome Letter, please reply Interested to confirm your participation. Best Regards, HR Department. Subject: HR Executive Internship. We are pleased to inform you that you have been selected for the Internship Program at Wellbridge Technologies. You may commence your internship on any date of your choice. The internship offers flexible onboarding to accommodate your availability. You are requested to inform us of your preferred joining date in advance to ensure a smooth and efficient onboarding process. Internship Benefits: Internship Completion Certificate, Letter of Recommendation (LOR), Stipend And Appreciation Letter from the company. To CONFIRM your enrolment, you are required to pay 1572/- online through the following link Internship Form.
